description: Fully-funded public schools because every child should have the opportunity to get a world-class education. I want to fight for effective community investment, ensuring our tax dollars are used wisely to fix our roads, support our main streets, and keep our neighborhoods safe. I want to fight for a balanced future by fostering smart corporate growth while protecting the agricultural heritage that makes Indiana special.
